name: artex-global
description: ARTEX 한국어판 · AI 자율 침투 테스트 프레임워크(upstream: Autumn-27/ARTEX, AGPL-3.0)

paragraphs: An autonomous penetration-testing system driven by LLM multi-agents (Go backend + Next.js frontend)

The UI and generated output default to English, and can be switched to Korean, Chinese, Spanish or Japanese in Settings (System → Settings → Display language). Changing the language also changes the language of agent-generated reports, summaries and chat replies.

## 🚨 Security & misuse warning — read this first This repository is published for use only within authorized environments, and only to build defensive and detection capabilities. ARTEX is an autonomous offensive tool powerful enough to carry an attack from reconnaissance through intrusion to data exfiltration with little human involvement, so the harm from misuse is correspondingly large.
